exposure: Digital examination of cervix for consistency (pre- and post-induction)
Sonography for cervical length (pre- and post-induction)
cohort: The study included 64 pregnant women with an indication for induction of labor with oxytocin.
finding: Evaluation of cervical consistency using either elastosonography or digital examination was found to be insignificant in predicting successful vaginal delivery after induction of labor with oxytocin.
mod_finding: The study found that elastosonography and digital examination were insignificant in predicting the mode of birth (vaginal vs. cesarean delivery) after induction of labor.
